learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn about differential calculus of more-variable real functions.
In the second part students will get the basic practical skills for working with fundamental concepts, methods and applications of integral calculus of more-variable real functions.

syllabus_topics: More-variable real functions. Partial and directional derivatives, differential and gradient.
Definition of double integral, basic properties. Fubini theorems for double integral.
Transformation of double integral, aplications of double integral.
Definition of triple integral, basic properties. Fubini theorems for triple integral.
Transformation of triple integral, aplications of triple integral.
